comments.overrides: next pins postcss 8.4.31, which carries three high-severity advisories (XSS via unescaped </style> in stringify output, plus two sourceMappingURL path-traversal/file-disclosure issues). No published next release has moved off it -- 16.2.12 is latest and still pins it -- so forcing the patched 8.5.x here is the only fix available. It's a semver-minor bump that tailwind already runs in this same tree. Note npm audit's own suggested fix is to downgrade next to 9.3.3; never run `npm audit fix --force` on this project.
comments.sharp: npm audit still reports sharp <0.35 (libvips CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591). Deliberately NOT overridden: next declares sharp ^0.34.5, so forcing 0.35 would break out of the range next tests against, and it can only be validated on the Linux runtime Vercel builds on, not locally. Those CVEs all require decoding attacker-supplied image bytes, and nothing here ever does -- there are no upload endpoints, no next/image usage, and no images.remotePatterns config, so the optimizer never fetches a remote source. The opengraph-image routes render text only. Revisit when next widens the range.
